baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ن ف ق verbs at 57:10.4/16/26 are set beside God's ميراث at 57:10.9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate wealth-outflow is nested inside an unavoidable succession: what present holders refuse to release will leave their control anyway, while the whole estate passes back under God's title.

activation_trace.role: Outgoing wealth supplies voluntary release as the operative act.
Transfer from predecessor to heir supplies the terminal succession that makes retention temporary.

changed_reading.before: Spending is a loss from property securely owned by the giver.
changed_reading.after: Spending is a voluntary transfer made before unavoidable succession removes the holder's control.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 57:10 denies equality and assigns greater degree to spending and fighting before the فتح while promising good to both cohorts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening is a phase change from closure to widened access. The same outward acts carry greater diagnostic weight while entry and outcome remain closed and reciprocal combat remains exposed; later performance remains good but is less costly evidence of commitment.

activation_trace.role: Comparison between two sides supplies the expressly denied equivalence.
A closure opening into a wider entrance supplies the decisive phase transition.
Reciprocal combat supplies exposed contest in both cohorts.
Step-by-step gradation supplies ranked value without excluding the later cohort.

changed_reading.before: The amount or kind of sacrifice alone determines rank.
changed_reading.after: Identical acts are weighted by phase: commitment before access opens reveals more than action after success is visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: 57:7 makes present possession successor-tenure: holders stand in for predecessors and are commanded to send wealth onward. This converts the focus's inheritance argument from terminal reversion alone into present custodial circulation.

activation_trace.role: Inheritance supplies transfer away from a prior holder.
The earlier repeated command supplies actual outgoing wealth, not merely an ownership claim.
One thing succeeding and standing in another's place supplies delegated, replaceable tenure.

structural_cues: 57:7 precedes the focus, repeats the expenditure command, and places successor-status between command and reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outgoing wealth and successors standing in predecessors' place; I infer that spending enacts custody rather than invading absolute ownership; live alternative: succession may ground duty without specifying a circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Give before God eventually inherits what remains.
changed_reading.after: Pass onward what is already held in succession; the spender is a temporary custodian inside an ongoing transfer chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: 57:11 recodes expenditure as a portion cut away for a return, then increased by its like. The focus's apparent depletion becomes the outgoing leg of a return circuit rather than terminal diminution.

activation_trace.role: Wealth leaving the holder supplies the circuit's outgoing leg.
A portion of wealth cut off so its recompense returns supplies recoverable advance rather than pure loss.
Increase by another like supplies enlargement on the returning leg.

structural_cues: 57:11 immediately follows the focus and answers its expenditure question with a loan-return construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut portion due recompense and increase by its like; I infer that divine recompense closes the focus's outflow into a circuit; live alternative: the return may be wholly non-material and need not mirror the original asset.

changed_reading.before: Spending relinquishes wealth before inevitable reversion.
changed_reading.after: Spending is an advance removed now whose divinely promised return exceeds the released portion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The long interval followed by heart-hardening makes the focus's before/after distinction a change in receptivity, not clock time alone. The next ayah's revival of dead earth keeps later recovery possible, matching unequal degrees alongside a good promise to both cohorts.

activation_trace.role: Opening supplies the focus's boundary between two conditions of action.
Gradation supplies unequal rank without making the later state unrecoverable.
Long duration supplies delay as an active condition rather than a neutral date.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies the state-change produced across delay.
Earth brought alive through growth supplies recoverability after hardening.
Lifeless land supplies the apparently closed state from which revival proceeds.

structural_cues: 57:16-17 form a hardening-then-revival sequence after the focus and its repeated loan promises.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies long delay leading to hard hearts and dead earth restored to life; I infer that this sequence explains both the focus's timing premium and its retained promise to later actors; live alternative: the rank difference may concern historical danger alone.

changed_reading.before: Before the opening is only an earlier, riskier historical date.
changed_reading.after: Before the opening also marks responsive action before delay hardens receptivity, while later revival remains possible but differently ranked.

context_deltas.mechanism: 57:25 coordinates measured justice, iron, and support. Read back into the focus, spending and fighting are not free-standing proofs of merit: released resources and force gain rank as jointly calibrated means of sustaining justice while support remains unseen.

activation_trace.role: Outgoing wealth supplies the resource instrument in the focus pair.
Reciprocal combat supplies the force instrument in the focus pair.
The balance of justice supplies a norm that measures both instruments.
Equity supplies the purpose against which expenditure and force are calibrated.
Iron's resistant hardness supplies material force rather than generalized sacrifice.
Aid that makes a cause prevail supplies the common function of the paired acts.

structural_cues: 57:25 pairs book-and-balance with iron, then closes on who supports God and His messengers unseen; this echoes 57:10's spend-and-fight pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies justice as measure, iron as force, and aid as function; I infer that these calibrate the focus's paired acts rather than merely follow them thematically; live alternative: 57:25 may state a broader mission without constraining 57:10's ranking.

changed_reading.before: Spending and fighting are two independently meritorious sacrifices.
changed_reading.after: Resource release and force are coordinated instruments whose rank depends on timely support of an equitable order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links the focus's spending root to its later hypocrite use beside a literal wall and door. It remains anchored in repeated ن ف ق, سبيل, and فتح in 57:10 and in exact branch-backed passage images at 57:13. Render it only as a lexical-spatial activation, never as an equation of every non-spender with a hypocrite.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats ن ف ق around God's path and contrasts action before and after an opening.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating burrow with an outlet supplies wealth-release as passage through, not mere subtraction.
An extended traversable road supplies the directed route of that passage.
A closed entrance opening wide supplies the temporal aperture that separates the cohorts.
A displayed entrance with a concealed exit supplies the asymmetric-passage counterimage.
A high enclosing wall supplies the later blockage around attempted access.
A doorway supplies visible access that does not guarantee passage to the desired side.

changed_reading.before: Failure to spend is simple retention, and the opening only changes external risk.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus tests passage integrity: genuine commitment lets wealth exit along God's path before access opens, unlike later one-sided access-seeking without prior outflow.

strongest_changes: 57:7 turns terminal inheritance into present successor-stewardship.
57:11 turns expenditure's outflow into a cut-away advance with an enlarged return.
57:16-17 makes before/after a contrast in receptivity with possible revival, while 57:25 calibrates spending and fighting by just support.
summary.what_was_special: The same ن ف ق root later names hypocrites beside a wall with a door; together with the focus's path and opening, this activated a contained passage-integrity reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ميراث implies present custodianship or only God's final title.
Whether hardening and revival explain the degree difference or merely echo its chronology.
Whether the wall-door topology is intended lexical interplay or accidental branch resonance.
Whether 57:25 directly calibrates the focus pair or states a broader mission.
